focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期规则落地，中国出口企业面临碳成本核算新挑战
focus.summary: 本周，欧盟正式发布碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期实施细则，明确2026年10月起进口商须提交产品碳排放数据。该机制覆盖钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢能六大行业，中国企业出口相关产品至欧盟需提前建立碳核算体系。欧盟同时宣布将逐步取消免费配额，预计2034年完全实施。此举标志着全球贸易碳壁垒加速形成，中国出海企业须将碳合规纳入供应链管理核心环节，避免因数据缺失面临额外碳税成本。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会官方公报 · 2026年7月15日
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transition Rules Finalized, Chinese Exporters Face New Carbon Cost Challenges
focus.summary_en: This week, the European Union officially released the transitional implementation rules for the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), requiring importers to submit product carbon emission data starting October 2026. The mechanism covers six sectors: steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, electricity, and hydrogen. Chinese exporters of these products to the EU must establish carbon accounting systems in advance. The EU also announced a gradual phase-out of free allowances, with full implementation expected by 2034. This move signals the formation of global trade carbon barriers, urging Chinese overseas enterprises to integrate carbon compliance into core supply chain management to avoid additional carbon tax costs due to data gaps.
focus.source_en: Source: Official Journal of the European Commission · July 15, 2026

case.title: 英国高等法院驳回中企投资仲裁管辖权异议，东道国措施合法性审查标准引关注
case.summary: 本周，英国高等法院就某中国新能源企业在英投资仲裁案作出管辖权裁定，驳回东道国关于“投资未获批准”的管辖权异议。法院认定，中英双边投资协定中的“公平公正待遇”条款可独立于国内审批程序适用。该案启示：中国出海企业即使未完成全部行政备案，仍可援引BIT保护；但需注意仲裁庭对“投资合法性”的实质审查趋势，建议在投资架构设计阶段即嵌入合规证据链。
case.source: 来源：英国高等法院商事法庭 · 2026年7月14日
case.title_en: UK High Court Rejects Jurisdictional Challenge in Chinese Investor Arbitration, Sets Precedent on Treaty Protection
case.summary_en: This week, the UK High Court ruled on a jurisdictional challenge in an investment arbitration brought by a Chinese new energy company against the UK, rejecting the host state's argument that the investment lacked approval. The court held that the 'fair and equitable treatment' clause under the China-UK Bilateral Investment Treaty can apply independently of domestic approval procedures. The case suggests that Chinese overseas enterprises may invoke BIT protection even without completing all administrative filings, but should be aware of tribunals' substantive review of investment legality. It is advisable to embed compliance evidence chains during investment structuring.
case.source_en: Source: Commercial Court, UK High Court · July 14, 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境纠纷多元化解机制升级，深圳国际仲裁院新规则引入临时措施与第三方资助
policy.summary: 本周，深圳国际仲裁院发布新版仲裁规则，自2026年9月1日起施行，重点优化跨境商事争议解决效率。新规明确仲裁庭可依申请发布临时措施（含资产冻结、证据保全），并首次允许第三方资助仲裁，但要求披露资助方信息以防利益冲突。同时，大湾区跨境调解平台与法院诉调对接机制进一步深化，企业可在线申请调解并快速获得司法确认。此举将降低跨境交易争议解决成本，建议出海企业优先在合同中约定深圳国际仲裁院管辖。
policy.source: 来源：深圳国际仲裁院 · 2026年7月16日
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Upgrades Cross-Border Dispute Resolution: New SCIA Rules Introduce Interim Measures and Third-Party Funding
policy.summary_en: This week, the Shenzhen Court of International Arbitration (SCIA) released its new arbitration rules, effective September 1, 2026, focusing on enhancing efficiency in cross-border commercial dispute resolution. The new rules empower tribunals to issue interim measures (including asset freezes and evidence preservation) upon application, and for the first time permit third-party funding of arbitration, subject to disclosure of funder details to avoid conflicts of interest. Additionally, the Greater Bay Area cross-border mediation platform has deepened integration with court litigation, allowing enterprises to apply for mediation online and obtain swift judicial confirmation. This move will reduce the cost of resolving cross-border transaction disputes, and it is recommended that overseas enterprises prioritize SCIA jurisdiction in their contracts.
policy.source_en: Source: Shenzhen Court of International Arbitration · July 16, 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：碳合规与投资保护成出海双主线，企业须提前布局数据与仲裁条款
analysis.summary: 本周三大动态（欧盟CBAM细则、英国仲裁管辖权案、大湾区仲裁新规）共同指向一个趋势：绿色贸易壁垒与法律工具升级并行。对出海企业建议：第一，立即启动出口欧盟产品的碳足迹核算，建立可追溯的数据台账，建议采用ISO 14067标准；第二，在投资合同中明确约定ICSID或SCIA等国际仲裁机构，并嵌入公平公正待遇条款；第三，利用大湾区新规中的临时措施机制，在争议初发时快速申请保全。下周关注：美国拟发布对华半导体设备出口管制新规，以及RCEP第二次降税安排生效。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 律连全球 · 2026年7月17日
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Carbon Compliance and Investment Protection Emerge as Dual Priorities for Overseas Expansion; Enterprises Must Proactively Arrange Data and Arbitration Clauses
analysis.summary_en: Three key developments this week—EU CBAM implementing rules, the UK arbitration jurisdiction case, and the Greater Bay Area's new arbitration rules—collectively point to a trend: green trade barriers and upgraded legal tools are advancing in parallel. Recommendations for overseas enterprises: First, immediately initiate carbon footprint accounting for products exported to the EU, establish traceable data ledgers, and adopt ISO 14067 standards. Second, clearly designate international arbitration institutions such as ICSID or SCIA in investment contracts, and embed fair and equitable treatment clauses. Third, utilize the interim measures mechanism under the new Greater Bay Area rules to quickly apply for preservation when disputes first arise. Next week's watch: the US is expected to issue new export controls on semiconductor equipment to China, and the second round of RCEP tariff reductions will take effect.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · iGlobal Law · July 17, 2026
